verdict.rationale: Browserbase lets you turn a completed Agent run into a reusable Stagehand script via the Optimize tool, and that script could be versioned in external source control. Run history can be reviewed through event history, logs, and session replay. However, nothing shows native versioning, change review, or rollback of deployed agents or automations. missing for 10: native automation version history, diff/review workflow for automation changes, rollback to prior versions, independent corroboration.
